title: Shared-CU vertex/fragment draws in a resident typed tile pass

contract.pass: One snapshotted typed tile descriptor binds persistent color and depth/stencil residency. Multiple serialized draws reuse it through explicit end/cancel/fault. Attachment begin/load/clear/discard follows the existing pixel service; pass completion is local retirement, not external image publication.
contract.draw: Versioned general GPU vertex/fragment descriptors plus front/back late test state. Pass identity, sample mode, enabled color location types and effective raster bounds are checked before shader admission. Zero/oversize screen dimensions use the raster elaboration-bound fallback; scissor intersection must be empty or inside this tile.
contract.pipeline: Existing vertex fetch, shared-CU vertex shader, clipping/viewport, triangle raster/interpolation, shared-CU fragment shader, final coverage/discard/depth override, late depth/stencil and typedMRT color storage share one ordered lifetime. Four color locations and four sample-mask bits are required at elaboration.
contract.ordering: Snapshot per-draw state into a retained pixel packet; capture only when the pixel owner is idle. Once offered, defer child cancellation until acceptance. On failure/cancel drain later source exports with an explicit dropped count. Draw completion waits for source and every admitted pixel completion; younger draws cannot overtake.
contract.contexts: Payload contexts captured at pass begin and supplied to both shader clients. Keep enclosing busy/VM ownership through interdraw idle, source/payload release, offered pixel/draw/pass completions, and every outstanding child transaction.
contract.faults: Pixel faults cancel shaders; source faults cancel pixels. Retain first fault stage/address/offset and immutable held results. Draw/pass retirement drains source task/router/memory/payload work and pixel memory/refill work before rebinding. A failed pass can contain a counted committed prefix.
contract.maintenance: Exclusive word maintenance only between draws; do not start a draw/end while an accepted maintenance reply is outstanding. The existing bounded64-bit refill interface remains an external backing-owner responsibility.
contract.uniforms: Each draw test uses an immutable scratch/uniform view. Direct CPU backing edits behind residentGPU cache lines are not a publication mechanism; native resource coherence remains outside this internal owner.
contract.scope: Internal one-tile hardware composition. Native bin/host descriptor admission, framebuffer backing/alias ownership, transfers/publication, format-aware blend/dither/resolve and widerH0-H8 gates remain open.

coverage: Real two-CU local/global execution:8draws/profile across1x/4x, indexed/instanced vertices, clipped/interpolated geometry and four mixed normalized/unsigned/signed/half-float locations. Independent raster/depth/stencil/encoding byte model verifies final resident words after each draw.
Repeated-depth rejection, shader override and discard, helper suppression, snapshot mutation and zero clear-start attachment refills; VM context remains held between draws and through completions.
One1024-byte payload slot: blocked vertex release retains its lease while fragments spill globally and reach resident typed attachments; no allocation cycle.
Valid tile/scissor intersection, empty scissors, empty vertex sources, retained attachments and simultaneous final draw/end.
Seven cross-tile/type/version/sample/bounds preflight failures cause no shader memory accesses; existing source descriptor failure and input-memory fault preserve attribution through pass completion.
Pulsed pre-start cancellation, queued launches/payload pins, held pixel results and immutable held draw/pass completions; healthy reuse.
Load-start refills, held refill/pool cancellation and reverse pixel refill-fault cancellation to shader owner, all accepted exports accounted and healthy reuse.
Seven existing vertex/fragment ownership tests and24existing typed/legacy pixel/numeric/storage checks.
validation.limits: No backing-image publication, native host/bin integration, blend, new throughput/frame rate or synthesis PPA claim.

emission.scope: Default owner has four-CU routing interfaces and external shared payload ports; no instantiated CU or payload pool. Thirty-three existing256x64 macros cover attachment and existing vertex/fragment private SRAM. Additional packet/descriptor/control registers are outside SRAM counts. Three existing fixed-function FMA/divider pairs for clip/viewport/interpolation remain unchanged. Structural RTL audit, not synthesis PPA.

remaining: Native geometry/bin/host/pass integration with backing attachment allocation, alias/permission validation, transfers and publication.
Format-aware blend, dither, resolve and full format/API state semantics.
General primitives, texture/resources, workload/throughput gates and originalH0-H8 closure.
Synthesis-only PPA qualification; no new place-and-route requirement.
